create_jinja_prompt_config: create a JinjaPromptConfig dataclass instance with a custom Jinja template string
set_input_variables: set input_variables on JinjaPromptConfig to specify template variable names
set_partial_variables: set partial_variables on JinjaPromptConfig to provide default values for template variables
validate_jinja_prompt_config: validate a JinjaPromptConfig instance by calling its validate method
configure_jinja_template: configure a JinjaPromptConfig with template, input_variables, and partial_variables fields
